reviewNotes: HOLD. Tune Talk currently sells a RM35 365-day credit-validity extension and independent users have long used the mechanism for low-maintenance numbers. However, Malaysia's binding 2026 prepaid-registration standard automatically terminates tourist-registered prepaid lines after a maximum of three months. The 365-day mechanic is therefore relevant only to eligible non-tourist cohorts; do not generalize it to a foreign tourist/China-based acquisition route.

events.outcome: Tune Talk currently offers RM35 for 365-day validity on listed prepaid plans, but Malaysia's 26 Feb 2026 mandatory prepaid-registration standard limits tourist-registered SIMs to a maximum three months before automatic termination. The one-year validity mechanism is preserved for eligible subscriptions without representing it as a durable tourist route.

data.acquisitionSummary: Tune Talk is a Malaysian mobile provider operating with CelcomDigi network collaboration. Current prepaid service supports new-number/eSIM paths, while the one-year validity service is an add-on for eligible existing prepaid plan cohorts rather than a special tourist-retention exception.

keep.action: For eligible Tune Talk Pek Epik/Pek Jimat/Hi-Value/Cun Value/Value Prepaid cohorts, subscribe to the RM35 365-day validity service in the app or by supported SMS/USSD flow. It does not auto-renew; re-subscribe annually before expiry.

data.chinaActivation: A durable mainland-China-first/tourist acquisition path is not supported by current Malaysian regulation. Tourist-registered prepaid lines terminate automatically after a maximum of three months under the 2026 mandatory standard.
data.kyc: Malaysia's 2026 mandatory prepaid-registration standard imposes secure identity verification and stricter non-citizen registration. Tourist lines have a maximum three-month lifetime; longer retention requires an eligible non-tourist registration cohort rather than a workaround.
data.payment: The validity service is purchased through Tune Talk App or supported SMS/USSD mechanisms; foreign-card/remote mainland payment reliability is not established.
data.roamingSms: Current evidence does not establish mainland-China incoming-SMS/OTP reliability for this route. Do not treat general roaming support as proof of third-party OTP delivery.
data.refund: The one-year validity subscription is non-cancellable after subscription according to current FAQ.
data.holdReason: The RM35/365-day provider mechanism is current, but tourist-registered Malaysian prepaid SIMs are automatically terminated after at most three months under the 2026 mandatory standard. A durable foreign-user cohort and China-side roaming/OTP path are unresolved.
data.tariffSummary: RM35/365-day validity is current for eligible plan cohorts; tourist-registered prepaid lines are capped at three months by Malaysia's 2026 mandatory registration standard.
guideSteps: Confirm that the subscriber qualifies for a non-tourist registration cohort before relying on one-year validity.
Subscribe to RM35 365-day validity through the official Tune Talk flow if the line is eligible.
Do not use tourist registration or identity workarounds to bypass the three-month regulatory limit.
